autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a foundation builds past the deal
playing: Move cards to build the foundations

tutorial.foundation: Eight foundations sit in the middle, pre-seeded with the Aces from both decks. Build each up by suit from Ace to King; getting all eight to the King wins.
tutorial.stock: Turn the stock one card at a time onto the waste and look for a place to put it. There is no redeal — you get a single pass.
tutorial.tableau: The tableau is a square of twelve columns of four. A card can only be stacked on one of the same suit exactly one rank higher. An empty column accepts anything.
tutorial.runs: Group moves are the heart of this game. Cards that already run down in the same suit can be carried together — pick the head of the run and the whole block moves.
tutorial.controls: Use the draw, hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toFoundation: Send this card to a foundation to free up the board.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to dig out the cards underneath.
hintReason.draw: Nothing on the board can move, so turn a card from the stock.
